products: Meta builds the Family of Apps (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp) plus Reality Labs (VR/AR hardware and software) and a growing AI stack: Meta AI agents, business agents on messaging apps, recommendation systems, and developer-facing model APIs such as Muse. Mission is connection at consumer scale with ads as the primary business model.
fiscal_outlook: Public company (NASDAQ: META). Q2 2026 revenue about $60.8B (+28% YoY) with heavy CapEx on AI infrastructure and weak free cash flow that quarter. Headcount ended Q2 near 75,000 after a May 2026 reduction of roughly 8,000 roles, while leadership still emphasized hiring technical and AI talent. Strong FoA ads growth; RL remains investment-heavy.
hiring_trends: Selective post-cut hiring continues on metacareers.com for staff-shaped fullstack (GO Systems Hack/React), infra SWE, recsys staff+, and LLM Business Agent support eng. Ads Attribution Staff and PE MLOps M1 still signaled via HM LinkedIn outreach. Hybrid hubs (Austin, Sunnyvale, Bellevue, Menlo) dominate; true remote uncommon.
similar_role_hires: Re-verified live 2026-08-06: GO Systems staff fullstack, Infrastructure SWE, Recommendation Systems (12+), Business Support Engineer Meta Business Agent. Skipped Tel Aviv Staff Systems role for Denver location fit.
hiring_profile: High volume of real metacareers.com postings with deep JDs and multi-location lists (Bay Area, Bellevue, Austin, etc.)—not sparse one-offs. Bar is steep (often 8–12+ years for staff-shaped roles). Hybrid/onsite hubs dominate; true remote is uncommon. Ghost-job risk exists given evergreen infra reqs, but many listings resolve to live Apply pages.
